notes: A new portal gets a star’s name (Vega, Altair, Rigel …), one none of your other portals has, given once and never changed by itself; Rename stays yours. Portals named by earlier versions for their screen or shape (Wide, Bar, Round …, Omen…
Editor › Customize: a layer’s actions are icons at the top of its section (move up, move down, show or hide) with Remove set apart as the one that deletes, and an Undo for a few seconds after it.

Smaller windows: every tile in the editor (themes, layouts, sizes, Touch) is a fixed small tile instead of stretching across the page, and the editor and the Control Panel open as tool windows of at most 1280 × 900.
